entities.summary: Theodotus of Antioch, patriarch of Antioch, in 417 succeeded Alexander of Antioch, under whom the long-standing schism of Meletius at Antioch had been healed, and followed his lead in replacing the honoured name of John Chrysostom on the diptychs of the church.
